faqs.a:
(a)
Any violation of this chapter shall be punished by a fine or imprisonment not to exceed
               the limits established in
section 1-5
of this Code.
(b)
A person convicted under
section 14-11
of this Code shall be punished by a minimum fine of $500.00, none of which may be
               suspended, and any additional fine or imprisonment which, when combined with the mandatory
               minimum fine, does not exceed the limits established in
section 1-5
of this Code. The court may also impose any, or all, of the special sanctions authorized
               under
section 14-6
(b) of this article.
(Code 1981, § 6-7; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998;
Ord. No. 4028, § 4, 10-16-2006
)
